hybridReplacement.reason: Six unfinished original hybrid workers disappeared after the launcher interruption. All 24 hybrid cases repeated durably, using unchanged controller files, to avoid selecting only early finishes. Comparisons use the replacement batch; provider-failed trials remain missing outcomes.

baselineReplacement.reason: Original launcher exited with SIGTERM; seven baseline workers disappeared without final records. Cause unknown. All eight baseline cases repeated as one later batch. Baseline comparisons are exploratory and have a different concurrency window.
